description: Liminal analysis engine — three-part output schema. MVP: analysis layer output shown directly to user (writing layer deferred).

input_schema.user_question: string or null — explicit question if Plan A; null if Plan B

card.$ref: See tarot_card_schema.md for full card object structure

input_schema.raw_transcript: string — verbatim ASR output, preserving fillers, self-corrections, and pause markers e.g. [pause 2.1s]

features.first_person_density: float — count of I/me/my/myself / total word count

analysis_layer_output.description: MVP: shown directly to user in structured format. Writing layer polish deferred to post-P3.

part_1_projection.label: What your words reveal
part_1_projection.description: Projection analysis — what the user's language patterns indicate about their inner state and cognitive framework

deviation_signals.description: Dimensions where user language deviates from card theme_space (delta >= 0.3) — these are the primary signals

item_schema.interpretation: string — direct judgment, not hedged description. What this deviation means psychologically.

item_schema.plain_explanation: string — what this archetype means in non-jargon language

item_schema.raw_evidence: string — exact quote or feature value

shadow_hints.note: Framed as sharp questions, not vague possibilities

mirrored_phrases.description: User's own words to quote back — minimum 3 phrases

core_judgment.description: The single most important finding — 2-3 sentences, direct, no hedging. If Plan A: must directly address user_question.

part_2_synchronicity.label: This card, right now
part_2_synchronicity.description: Synchronicity integration — what it means that THIS card appeared at THIS moment, given the projection analysis. Not fortune-telling. The card as meaningful coincidence in dialogue with the user's current state.

card_meaning_now.description: The card's symbolic meaning stated as a psychological dynamic, not a fortune

tension_with_projection.description: Where the card's theme and the user's projection create productive tension — what the gap between them points to

synchronicity_statement.description: One direct statement about why this card appearing now is meaningful — integrates card + user's current state. Acknowledges the non-causal meaningful coincidence without reducing it to either pure symbolism or pure psychology.

reversed_note.description: If card is reversed: what the reversal specifically shifts or intensifies in this reading. Null if upright.

part_3_closing_question.label: A question to carry
part_3_closing_question.description: One specific question derived from the most significant finding in Part 1. Not generic. Not therapeutic homework. A question that opens something rather than closes it. The reading ends here — no further dialogue.

constraints: Derived from the core_judgment or most significant deviation_signal — not a template
Specific enough to be answerable in one sitting of reflection
Opens toward the user's own knowing, not toward the product
Does not prescribe action or imply what the answer should be

part_3_closing_question.derivation: string — internal note explaining which finding this question comes from (not shown to user)

longitudinal_storage.description: Data stored for future trait/state analysis. MVP: store only, do not display.
longitudinal_storage.note: Longitudinal pattern analysis (trait vs state separation) activated at P4 when sufficient sessions accumulated

pipeline_notes.mvp_output: Analysis layer output shown directly to user (parts 1-3). Writing layer (prose rendering) deferred to post-P3.
pipeline_notes.layer_separation: Analysis layer must complete before any output is shown. Never merge analysis and writing in one prompt.
pipeline_notes.no_fabrication: No invented Jungian citations. Conceptual references only ('the Jungian concept of projection') unless quoting public domain works (pre-1928 English).
pipeline_notes.display_order: Part 1 → Part 2 → Part 3. Part 2 (card meaning) shown AFTER projection analysis to prevent anchoring bias.
pipeline_notes.plan_a_b: Plan A (user_question provided): Part 1 core_judgment must directly address the question. Plan B (user_question null): analysis from language only.
pipeline_notes.session_closes_after_part_3: No dialogue continuation. User action after reading: save / start new reading only.
